title: Extending the Bipartite Parking Space
summary: We prove an analogue of a theorem of Berget and Rhoades about extending the parking space $\mathrm{Park}_n$ to an $S_{n+1}$-module $\mathrm{Slim}_n$. Specifically, we show that the \textit{bipartite parking space} $\mathrm{Park}_{K_{n,m}}$, which naturally comes with an $S_{n-1} \times S_m$ action, extends to an $S_n \times S_m$-representation $\mathrm{Slim}_{n,m}$. We then formulate a conjecture generalizing this statement to any simple graph.
